name: Station telemetry stale-data flag
aliases: substations Substation automation and command interfaces
summary: Indicates that a measurement or status has exceeded its defined freshness condition.
description: Indicates that a measurement or status has exceeded its defined freshness condition. Station automation collects measurements and statuses and issues assigned commands through defined authority paths. A communicated point has a value, quality and equipment identity; it should not be treated as an unexplained contact.

In a substation control building, the station controller receives bay information and forwards an operator's selected command to the correct bay device. Device feedback confirms whether the intended result actually occurred. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Data age and quality” at the input and “Stale information flag” at the output. Stale data must remain distinguishable from a current value.
